status: new architectural candidate; no performance claim before validation
motivation: Remove expensive PRP evaluation on every padded index slot rather than paying for oblivious compaction
stored_locators: Distinct stable secret handles h_i in database and index copies; labels and stable tie tags remain secret as in R1
mask: Same independent MiMC mask-word keys, applied to semantic epoch locators
rekey: Refresh locator and mask keys; re-mask templates using old/new semantic locators; preserve handle values; verify binding and root/index relation; shuffle complete DB rows and refresh every persistent field share
relation_check: Check tuples(h,block,decoded_value). A global injective Pi maps this multiset bijectively to tuples(ell,block,decoded_value), so equality of handle relations is equivalent to equality of semantic-locator relations
privacy_boundary: Handles, index contents, labels, tags and mask keys remain secret. Same below-threshold passive MPC and exposed-masked-template snapshot boundary as R1. No stronger claim when logical handle values are exposed.
functional_difference: Changes representation/materialization schedule and locator update family. It is not bytewise state equivalence to R1's recursive Pi_new(old_locator). Virtual semantic epochs and physical slot rewriting are reported separately.
scope_of_claim: Candidate design with a written simulation/functional argument pending review. No post-compromise, malicious-MPC, OS-erasure or crash-atomicity extension.
fault_semantics: Missing/duplicated/misplaced/corrupted handle, wrong index transformation, wrong/stale template, coupled changed-root/index defect. An unchanged physical handle is correct in this representation, so R1 stale-index-value injection6 is not a corruption test here and must not be counted as rejected.
cost_hypothesis: Two N-record locator derivations per re-key instead of PRP on N+M records; full relation checks, share refresh and write costs retained. Query gains one N-record locator derivation. Both costs must be measured.
nonce_and_key_generation: Unchanged OS-random full-field independent contributions as R1
invariant_requirement: Bit-valid templates and validity; unchanged metadata association; identical Hamming results; one selected complete key/template/index bundle
decision_rule: Use only if its functional/privacy boundary is justified and measured end-to-end benefit is useful. Retain the eager design and all failed variants as controls.
